# moodle_group_member (Resource)

Adds a user to a Moodle group. The user must already be enrolled in the course.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "moodle_group_member" "jane_in_one" {
  group_id = moodle_group.team_one.id
  user_id  = moodle_user.student_jane.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (Number) The ID of the group.
- `user_id` (Number) The ID of the user to add to the group.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite ID of the group membership (groupid-userid).
